sources.title: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next - DGX Spark / GB10 - NVIDIA Developer Forums
sources.snippet: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next is a multimodal MoE model. It pairs a large parameter count with a smaller active count per token, plus a huge n-gram embedding table for fast local token lookups, on top of GDN and QSA mechanisms.

sources.title: Qwen/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next | vLLM Recipes
sources.snippet: Overview Qwen3.8-Flash-Next is a multimodal, ultra-sparse Mixture-of-Experts model. It has 125B parameters, including an additional 51B N-gram embedding table, while activating 6B parameters per token. The architecture combines four main ideas: GDN + QSA: three of every four layers use Gated DeltaNet to compress history; the fourth uses Qwen Sparse Attention for precise long-range retrieval ...

sources.title: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next: How to Run Locally - unsloth.ai
sources.snippet: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next is a new open-weight, 125B parameter MoE multimodal model from Qwen. Built on the new Qwen4 architecture, it supports a 262K context window and advanced reasoning. It can run locally on devices with 78GB RAM /unified memory without requiring GPU VRAM. The model outperforms Claude-4.6-Opus (Max) at agentic coding, vision, and chat. sources.title: Experiment with Qwen3.8-Flash-Next 176B Model on NVIDIA GB300 NVL72 for ...
sources.snippet: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next is designed for high-volume, context-intensive applications such as agentic coding, document processing, and tool-driven workflows. As context grows, attention compute and KV cache memory become bottlenecks. The model addresses both with a hybrid architecture combining Gated DeltaNet (GDN) and Qwen Sparse Attention (QSA).
